verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports automation triggers (Slack, GitHub, Linear, schedules, webhooks) and cloud/enterprise hosted execution with usage reporting and budget management, which implies multiple tasks can be kicked off and run without manual intervention, enabling some scale of parallel work. However, there is no explicit documentation of a concurrency model, multi-agent dashboard, or fleet-management UI for running and monitoring many simultaneous agent sessions. missing for 10: explicit docs on concurrent task limits/scheduling, a dashboard for tracking multiple in-flight agent runs, and independent evidence of teams running many agents in parallel.
